verdict.rationale: Payment platforms can plausibly offer user-configurable automations such as scheduled or recurring payment jobs, so this axis applies. The evidence only shows x402 as a per-request payment protocol: agents can pay mid-task without signups or approvals, agentic wallets hold funds, and batch settlement supports high-frequency agent loops. Those are developer building blocks that an agent built elsewhere could use, not a documented capability for setting up background automations within the product itself.
